description: This file defines quantization aware training (QAT) modules for convolution layers in PyTorch, including Conv1d, Conv2d, and Conv3d with fake quantization functionalities.

classes.name: _ConvNd
classes.description: A base class for quantized convolution modules, supporting weight fake quantization and conversion between float and quantized modules.

classes.name: Conv1d
classes.description: A 1D convolution module with FakeQuantize features for QAT, compatible with torch.nn.Conv1d.

classes.name: Conv2d
classes.description: A 2D convolution module with FakeQuantize features for QAT, compatible with torch.nn.Conv2d.

classes.name: Conv3d
classes.description: A 3D convolution module with FakeQuantize features for QAT, compatible with torch.nn.Conv3d.

methods.name: forward(self, input)
methods.description: Performs the convolution operation with quantized weights.

methods.name: from_float(cls, mod, use_precomputed_fake_quant=False)
methods.description: Creates a quantized convolution module from a floating point module.

methods.name: to_float(self)
methods.description: Converts the quantized module back to a floating point module.
